Production PIXEL ART for the existing Sproto fighting game. Crisp stepped pixels, dark outlines, compact limited-color shading. Not smooth vector or painterly art. Each cell contains exactly ONE complete actor facing RIGHT, consistent three-quarter side view. Preserve the reference identity, facial shape, exact eye count, colors, clothing, accessories and the specific body shape described below. Same head, torso and limb proportions in every frame. Exactly two arms and two legs per actor, legs rooted at the LOWEST pelvis below the belly. Low hip, chambered knee and connected ankle for every kick. Never attach legs to the chest. Keep all limbs and feet wholly inside their own cell with generous empty margins; no clipping. Flat solid pure MAGENTA #ff00ff background, no grid lines, labels, shadows, trails, floating particles or weapons. Worn/held identity accessories must remain attached to body or hand. Extend cropped lower bodies conservatively using matching skin/clothing colors and simple shoes. Complete separate body drawings; no limb cutouts. Both feet need readable soles. No extra subjects.

IDENTITY: Isolate ONLY the LARGE BLUE character on the RIGHT of the original. Large long round blue-violet bald-topped head and long thick blue torso, huge YELLOW almond eyes with small black pupils, blue eyelids and broad projecting BLUE nose with small dark nostril, asymmetric RED flat upper lip and separate small RED lower lip. Swept blue rear side spikes. Unclothed cartoon blue body, blue arms and fingered hands, sturdy blue legs and blue feet; no explicit anatomy detail. Exclude the yellow partner, red background and all other subjects. Draw ONLY this selected actor, never its partner. They have separate atlases. Dynamic coordinated action with strong anticipation and follow-through. Lead striker: powerful shoulder-driven straights, uppercuts and planted finishing palm. Match original face and clothing, no boxing gloves. Keep fully connected fingers, hands, feet and head. Each cell ONE complete body. Reference 2 when present locks full-body design and proportions.

Row 5 HEAVY RECOVERY: sustain extended side kick one beat; knee folds back; grounded follow-through; guard.
Row 6 AIR KICK: compact aerial coil; front knee chambers; knee opens; forceful extended diagonal kick to RIGHT, rear knee folded.
Row 7 AIR TO VICTORY: knee retracts in air; balanced airborne recovery; confident upright victory guard; victory knees coil.
Row 8 VICTORY: jubilant short hop with fist up; stylish landing crouch; proud standing hero stance; settled triumphant hero pose. No effects, no additional figures. Exactly 4 figures per row, 8 rows.
